verdict.rationale: Zep documents a few single-call operations that affect many items. Deleting a User removes all associated Threads and thread artifacts in one API call, deleting a node cascades to all connected edges, and `thread.add_messages` ingests multiple messages at once. These are narrow cascade and batch behaviors, not a general bulk-operations capability. missing for 10: general bulk/batch APIs for selecting and acting on arbitrary sets of items (e.g. bulk delete or update of many users, edges or nodes), documented batch-ingestion limits, bulk operations via zepctl, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Deleting a User will delete all Threads and thread artifacts associated with that User with a single API call
Deleting a node will also delete all edges connected to that node.
Chat messages are added to threads using thread.add_messages, which adds the messages to the thread history and ingests them into the user's Context Graph.
